## Summary

Prepare native creator artwork using the parsed button states and layout from #45–#46. This seven-file slice is stacked on #46; creator-screen wiring and gestures follow separately.

```text
AssetPack.rasterSymbol / rasterClip(buttonState)
  buttonDisplayList → recursive transform/color composition
    creatorFrames: 39 control poses + 2 tracks + 2 handles + 6 rings
```

Keep hit-only records out of ordinary painting, default to the up state, separate tracks from their handles, and release the added caches on disposal. This adds bitmap composition and does not add generic SimpleButton input or geometric contact.

## Evidence

- **Before:** The SVG compiler cannot compose button records; creator artwork states are unavailable to screen controls.
  **After:** Production APIs render separate synthetic up/over/down/hit colors, half alpha, translated bounds and a nested 2×3 transform. Native checks find ink in all 49 cached rasters and verify the recovered checked/unchecked, enabled/disabled and hover/down relationships.
- The isolated native gallery was visually inspected. It shows local bitmaps before screen-wrapper transforms; final creator placement and ring/track hairline contrast still need comparison.
- A bounded reachability audit finds no button descendants among the currently prepared Settings, edit-confirm, help, pause, Info, win, Credits, part or extra roots. Positive creator controls confirm the graph walk works.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 482 rule tests (6,030 assertions), production build and four affected browser cases pass (39.1 seconds), including ordinary and compressed SWF loading/navigation. The final two artwork cases pass again with standalone JSON proof files (6.6 seconds) after fixing a test-only missing attachment parameter.
- Original artwork remains runtime supplied. Broader SVG filter/blend limits, exact Flash pixels/input and complete creator/game parity remain open; the shipped button records have no filter/blend metadata.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes the added artwork cache and button composition. No profile or saved-design changes.

**Blast Radius:** rendering

Native loading now precomposes 49 additional rasters. The creator screen continues using its preceding presentation until the following UI integration.

input.body:
## Summary

Recover the pure arithmetic needed by the following creator-control integration. This four-file slice is stacked on #47 and does not connect new production handlers yet.

```text
selected parts
  nudgeSelection → X step, links unchanged
  centerSelection → source-ordered centering and selected twin removal
  selectedTransform → ghost-inclusive scale/angle means
```

Keep held/click scheduling, class updates, validation and history in the caller. Preserve the source's mutation-sensitive indexed centering walk rather than replacing it with stable iteration.

## Evidence

- **Before:** A stable-iteration variant centers the opaque owner after its faded twin is removed from an earlier selection slot.
  **After:** The recovered indexed walk follows the AS/pcode splice-and-increment ordering. The controlled variant fails only that regression (eight pass/one fail); the exact verified file is restored afterward. Ordinary input reachability of that ordering remains unverified.
- Four new rule cases cover selected twin merging, preserved unselected links, X steps, ghost-inclusive means, empty defaults, wrapped angles and the indexed splice case. The source arithmetic makes 45°/−45° average to 180°, not zero.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 486 rule tests (6,040 assertions) and production build pass. The helper has no production caller yet, so this slice changes no browser flow.
- Source: TankCreatorScreen `_F1`, `DeleteNonDominantTwinObject`, MoveLeft/Right and MoveSelectionLeft/Right, `_C8` and `_Bk`; pcode confirms selection splices and index increment. Runtime event phase, actual gestures and complete creator/game parity remain open.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes unused helper exports. No profile or design-format changes.

**Blast Radius:** selection

The following screen integration will consume these helpers and receive its own browser verification.
